lr_gr_details.sentence: English is very important today and taught in many schools since it helps to students with job and going other country.

inaccuracies.comment: The verb 'help' does not need 'to' before the object.

inaccuracies.content: with job and going other country
inaccuracies.revision: with jobs and travelling to other countries
inaccuracies.comment: Use plural nouns and a more natural phrase.

lr_gr_details.sentence: They is part of culture and histories.

inaccuracies.comment: In this context, 'history' is more natural as an uncountable/general noun.

focus.title: Improve verb forms and subject-verb agreement
focus.explanation: Focus on patterns such as 'people speak', 'it makes', 'they are', and 'everyone should learn'. These errors appear often and affect clarity.
